exposure: Joel-Cohen incision for hysterectomy due to placenta accreta spectrum
outcome: Baby's pre-delivery general anesthesia exposure time
Postoperative intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 161 women undergoing hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum
finding: Performing hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum through a Joel-Cohen incision with bladder dissection before delivery is safe and effective, reducing transfusion rates and avoiding midline incision complications.
